trust_decision.summary: The SH decoder trusts that the decoded instruction yields an operand position below the 3-entry sh_info.op.operands array, and that the decode-table index is in range. It decides this in set_reg_n/set_mem_n and in sh_disassemble. AT THE PINNED COMMIT THESE CHECKS ARE ALREADY PRESENT.

landing_point.why: The summary names sh_disassemble, and the decode-table indexing sits there. The operand writers set_reg_n/set_mem_n are in the same file at arch/SH/SHDisassembler.c:34-97.

fix_sites.module_kind: opcode handler (opMOV_rind; opMOVx, opMOV_L_dsp, op4xxb, opMOV_BW_dsp, opMOV_gbr, opFMOVm are changed the same way)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The third fix commit is a v5-branch backport of the same SHDisassembler.c change (fix.diff:1278-1511). It is the same file in another branch, not a second implementation in this tree.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Possible only for the unguarded set_imm and regs_read/regs_write writers: 'the report is about set_reg_n/set_mem_n operand positions, and immediates and register lists are a different array'. Moot, because the published fix is already applied at the pin.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Valid 2-operand SH/SH2A moves must still decode with op_count 2. A check that rejects pos >= 2 instead of >= 3, or that fails the whole instruction, would break legal 3-operand forms.

O6_input_shapes: fixed operand position passed by the handler (set_reg_n/set_mem_n with rw / 1-rw)
decode table index computed from the opcode nibbles

O8_uncovered_routes.route: set_imm writes operands[op_count] with no bound check, the same operand array as the fixed helpers
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Immediates were not named in the fix, and the published patch left them alone
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, lines above the fixed helpers

O8_uncovered_routes.route: regs_read/regs_write macros append to detail->regs_read/regs_write with no count bound
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different array (cs_detail register lists), not the operand array named in the advisory

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The DSP move handler writes operands[0..2].dsp with fixed indices. A computed index (as at :1600-1620 with xy) is a realistic place for an unchecked position.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The DSP paths already index operands by a decoded field (xy) and do not go through set_*_n.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The printer loops over op_count when reading operands. An unbounded op_count read is the read-side twin of the fixed write.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The printer trusts op_count from the decoder, which is the classic producer/consumer split.

O9_family: memory safety (native C): out-of-bounds write/read on a fixed-size operand array and decode-table index (CWE-125/787)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/integration/test_poc.c (PoC harness, already contains test_overflow_set_reg_mem_n at tests/integration/test_poc.c:78); SH MC/detail YAML tests under tests/ (unverified)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a single idx bound in sh_disassemble and leave set_reg_n/set_mem_n unchecked.
